caption:
Love does not make you question your mind It brings clarity to your spirit ❤️🙏

#love #newyork #mindfulness
transcript: One of the most painful experiences for a woman is not heartbreak. It is confusion. It is when she begins to question her own sanity because of the behavior of the man she loves. She gathers the courage to say, That hurt me. She speaks softly. She tries to explain. And instead of being met with understanding, she is met with anger, deflection, blame. The conversation turns. Suddenly she is too sensitive, overreacting, imagining things. And slowly she begins to doubt herself. This is not love. This is distortion. A boy protects his ego. A man protects her heart. A boy needs to win the argument. A man needs to understand the pain. A real man listens without turning the mirror away. He takes responsibility. He makes her feel seen, safe and steady. A woman should never feel crazy for wanting respect. She should never feel wrong for asking to be valued. Love does not make you question your mind. It brings clarity to your spirit. If you're tired of doubting yourself and carrying wounds no one sees, it's time to heal at the root. I created the 30-day healing journey to help you rebuild your confidence, your peace and your self-worth from within. If you're ready to truly heal, the link is in my profile.
